name: Integer sets whose pair sums never divide pair products
description: Return a nonempty subset of [1,256]. For every distinct a,b require (a*b)%(a+b)!=0. Maximize cardinality. The prescribed distinct-pair divisibility exclusion does not require the quotient to belong to the selected set, unlike the reciprocal Schur task. The source writes x,y without explicitly excluding equality; this implementation follows the bank's stated distinct-pair variant.
